items.title: Oracle Corporation (ORCL) vs. Amazon.com (AMZN): Which AI Infrastructure Giant Is Better Positioned for Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: On August 13, Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) and Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)’s Web Services announced a major expansion of their strategic collaboration. The marquee news was the general availability of Oracle Exadata Database Service on Exascale Infrastructure via Oracle AI Database@AWS. The joint offering brings Exadata-grade performance and pay-per-use economics to enterprise workloads across 22 AWS regions […]

items.title: Dow Giant Walmart Sinks To A 9-Month Low; Ross Stores Stock Jumps
